# TorqHive

> TorqHive is a premier industrial hardware exporter and tool manufacturer based in Zhejiang, China. We specialize in precision mechanical hand tools, professional torque systems, and next-generation cordless brushless power tools for global trade, industrial distributors, and custom OEM/ODM programs.

## Core Capabilities & Product Lines
- **Precision Hand Tools**: 40+ export-ready SKUs spanning ratchets, socket sets, extra-long wrenches, calibrated torque wrenches, and automotive specialty tools.
- **Power Tools R&D**: Next-generation 20V brushless cordless platforms, smart digital torque systems, and high-capacity Li-ion power solutions.
- **B2B Manufacturing & OEM**: Alloy forging, CNC precision machining, laser marking, custom blow-mold cases, and EVA foam trays.
- **Quality & Standards**: Traceable torque calibration, DIN/ISO standards, and CE/RoHS safety compliance audits.
- **Trade Terms**: Low MOQ starting from 1 unit, rapid sample dispatch, DDP/FOB shipping worldwide.
